request_messages.content:
Solve this Sudoku puzzle. Dots are empty cells.

.9...12..
.3..284.6
.6.....8.
.7....14.
.2..5.7..
..3.....2
.1.9.....
...7.5...
.872.6..4

Fill every cell so that each row, each column, and each 3x3 box contains the digits 1-9 exactly once.
The last line of your reply must be exactly:
FINAL: <the solved grid as one string of 81 digits, row by row, no spaces>
